priorityList: Use Avenging Wrath (or Radiant Glory) on cooldown, ideally while Expurgation is ticking on the target.
Cast Execution Sentence if Wake of Ashes is ready and the target will live at least 10 seconds.
Spend Holy Power if you are at the cap of 5 or if the free Hammer of Light buff is about to expire.
Cast Hammer of Light as your top priority finisher whenever available or procced.
Cast Divine Storm as your primary Holy Power spender when facing 3 or more targets or when Empyrean Power is active.
Cast Templar's Verdict as your spender if the Divine Storm conditions (3+ targets) are not met.
Cast Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is active (or on cooldown with Radiant Glory) to generate Holy Power.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown to generate Holy Power and apply Judgment to all targets.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power, prioritizing Art of War procs.
Cast Hammer of Wrath whenever available (during Avenging Wrath or on targets below 20% health).
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power and maintain its damage-taken debuff on the target.
Use Templar Strike and Templar Slash (or Crusader Strike) as filler to generate Holy Power when other generators are on cooldown.
Use offensive racials like Light's Judgment or Arcane Torrent as available.
Use damage potions and trinkets aligned with Avenging Wrath or Radiant Glory windows.
